description: This file defines a Go package 'aggregator' that implements a walker for references within an OpenAPI specification, including functions to traverse schemas, parameters, responses, and operations.

classes.name: readonlyReferenceWalker
classes.description: A struct that walks through references in an OpenAPI spec, calling a callback on each reference.

methods.name: walkSchema
methods.description: Recursively walks through a schema and its nested schemas, invoking the callback on references.

methods.name: walkParams
methods.description: Walks through a list of parameters, invoking walkParam on each.

methods.name: walkParam
methods.description: Walks through a parameter, invoking the callback on its reference and schema.

methods.name: walkResponse
methods.description: Walks through a response, invoking the callback on its reference and schema.

methods.name: walkOperation
methods.description: Walks through an API operation, including parameters and responses.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins walking through all paths and operations in the root Swagger spec.
